18 mm external plastering, sponge finish
Floor tiling with vitrified tiles incl. skirting
Toilet dado ceramic tiling
Terrace and sunk waterproofing treatment
Concealed electrical wiring with copper conductor per point
Concealed CPVC plumbing lines with fittings
Pre-construction anti termite treatment
Two coats acrylic emulsion on inside walls
Outside weatherproof painting

- Cost-to-Complete: ₹25,16,729
- Cost-to-Complete Gap: -₹2,124,764 (the difference between remaining sanction funds and estimated completion cost prior to stage verification)

1. Facilitate the upcoming site inspection or provide clear site progress photographs so our technical team can verify the completed work and determine the verified value.
2. Review your personal contribution / bridge financing to cover the estimated ₹5,16,728.68 total funding gap.
3. Take the following clarification and negotiation questions to your contractor regarding the BOQ:
   - Reinforcement Quantity: 'Could you provide the structural drawings and bar bending schedule to confirm whether 78.1 kg/cum of reinforcement is sufficient for the structural members?'
   - Steel Make: 'Could you please confirm the approved brand and make of TMT Fe 500 steel to be supplied for the project?'
   - Flooring: 'Could you please specify the brand, size, and price range of the vitrified tiles included in the quote?'
   - Wall Dado: 'Could you please clarify the brand, dimensions, and height of the ceramic dado tiling for the toilets?'
   - Electrical: 'Could you provide a detailed point schedule and brand specifications for the concealed electrical point wiring?' and 'Could you please confirm the approved brands for the copper wires, conduits, and modular switches?'
   - Plumbing: 'Could you share the brand, pipe schedule, and specific fittings included under each plumbing set?' and 'Could you please specify the brand and class/pressure rating of the CPVC pipes and fittings?'
   - Anti-Termite Treatment: 'Could you clarify the scope, chemical details, and warranty provided for the anti-termite treatment quoted at Rs 4,820 per sqm?' and 'Could you please confirm the chemical name, dilution ratio, and application standard to be used for the anti-termite treatment?'
   - Painting: 'Could you please confirm the brand and product line of acrylic emulsion paint to be applied on internal walls?' and 'Could you please specify the brand and product tier for the exterior weatherproof paint?'
